description: The version of this contract, the report schema versions it accepts and the operating systems a released analyzer supports. contract_version is the semantic version of the contract as one unit, independent of every analyzer's version and of this repository's release tags; it moves only when a document under contract/ changes in a way an implementation can observe, and every analyzer names the contract version it implements in its report and in its resolved configuration. schema_versions lists every value a report's schema_version field may carry under this contract version; a merge admits a report whose schema_version is in this list and refuses one that is not, naming both versions. A value moves when the report a consumer decodes changes shape: its major number when a member changes type, is added as required or stops being required, and its minor number when an optional member is added; a report is written to one shape, so a value is replaced rather than joined by a second unless this contract version admits two shapes at once. platforms is the closed set of operating systems every product supports, each spelled as the os field of a report configuration spells it; the set names operating systems only.
